services.name: Lewis Log Cabin
services.desc: The Lewis Log Cabin is an original log cabin complete with items used by pioneers of the time. It is like walking into a family’s home in 1860. The cabin was built by William Kesler in 1860 and was sold to Mr. Lewis in 1886. The Lewis family lived there until 1914.
